headline: RapWire 24/7: Yella Beezy, bbno$, Quavo, Sand In My Boots and GTA VI
caption:
1) Yella Beezy’s capital-murder trial over the 2020 killing of MO3 resumed in Dallas on Nov. 5. Prosecutors pressed testimony that linked Markies Conway to an alleged payment, while the defense challenged witness accounts and the limits of phone and location data. Conway has pleaded not guilty, and the case remains in trial rather than a final verdict. @yellabeezy214 @Rapwire247
2) bbno$ will headline The Internet for Palestine at L.A.’s Shrine Expo Hall on Nov. 7, a benefit for the Palestine Children’s Relief Fund. The all-ages event brings musicians, streamers and creators together, with ticket and donation support directed to PCRF’s medical relief work for children. It turns online reach into an in-person fundraiser before the weekend. @bbnomula @Rapwire247
3) Quavo dropped “One Hit Away” and its official video on Nov. 4, making the single the clearest public step yet toward SATCHAMO. No album release date has been confirmed, but the surprise drop keeps his solo rollout moving only a month after QRÖMELIFE. @quavohuncho @Rapwire247
4) Morgan Wallen’s Sand In My Boots returns to Gulf Shores May 21–23, 2027, with a rap-heavy lane led by Nelly, Gucci Mane and Rick Ross. The official lineup also includes Flo Rida, Juicy J, Project Pat and Ying Yang Twins, and public passes go on sale Nov. 6 at 10 a.m. Central. The crossover gives a country-led beach festival a serious hip-hop draw. @nelly @laflare1017 @richforever @Rapwire247
5) Rockstar dropped a new GTA VI Launch Gallery on Nov. 5 with 39 fresh screenshots, two weeks before the game’s Nov. 19 release. The images expand the official look at Jason, Lucia and the wider Leonida world, including Vice City and other regions, giving fans another visual checkpoint before launch. @rockstargames

@Rapwire247
